description: Defines classes and methods for managing a simple disk cache index in the Chromium project, including EntryMetadata and SimpleIndex classes with cache management functionalities.

classes.name: EntryMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata for cache entries, including last used time, size, and trailer prefetch size, with serialization support.

classes.name: SimpleIndex
classes.description: Manages a simple disk cache index, supporting insertion, removal, lookup, size management, and disk writing operations.
